bullets: Added graphs to your personal Poker stats: a bankroll-over-time chart, a win/loss chart per game, and a head-to-head breakdown of who you've won the most from (and lost the most to).
The group Hall of Fame now has a full sortable leaderboard table, a ranked net-winnings chart, and a games-per-month activity chart.

Adding a grocery or pantry item you already have now tops up the existing item instead of creating a duplicate row — even when the unit doesn't match exactly (e.g. "cups" vs "bag" now shows as a combined quantity you can edit).
Marking a grocery item as bought now moves it to your pantry with a quick animation instead of freezing the screen while it saves.
The edit screen for a grocery/pantry item now lets you edit every quantity on it, not just the first one.
Added a "Quick Meal" feature that is more flexible than the recipe option, allowing users to adjust what quantity of ingredients they are using each time they make it.
Recipes are gone — Quick Meals is now the one way to build a meal, since it turned out to just work better.
You can now paste a whole ingredient list and have it parsed into a Quick Meal in one shot, instead of adding items one at a time (the same AI parsing Recipes used to use).

Quick Meal items no longer have to already be in your pantry — you can add something "not tracked" (like a condiment you don't inventory) and it'll just sit there as a reminder without affecting your pantry when you log the meal.
The Meals tab is simpler now — one list, and the "+" in the top bar starts a new Quick Meal directly.
New Weather tool — an ad-free forecast with a live sky that rains, snows, storms, and shows the stars depending on the actual conditions.
Temperatures average three weather models (the National Blend of Models, ECMWF, and ICON), which tested more accurate than any single one against real airport readings.
Includes a next-2-hours rain timeline, hourly and 10-day forecasts, and official National Weather Service alerts.
Save as many places as you want and swipe between them.
New Hockey tool for college hockey: live D-I scores with your team pinned on top, refreshing every 30 seconds while games are on.
The weekly USCHO poll with each team's movement, plus a chart of where your team has ranked all season.
The NPI, the NCAA's tournament ranking, with where your team sits against the 16-team field.
A team page with a countdown to the next game, the full schedule and TV, conference standings, and box scores for Quinnipiac games.
Fixed the NPI screen going blank.
Tap any team in the poll, the NPI or standings to see its record, last results and next games, and follow it if you like.
A projected NCAA field: the 16-team bracket if the season ended today, with the last four in and first four out.
Quinnipiac's stat leaders: points, goals and assists for every skater, plus each goalie's record, GAA and save percentage.
A weekly poll recap: who rose, who fell, who's new, and where your team landed.
